blinding: All scores and adjudications finalized without inspecting condition labels, selected strategies, raw traces, or any held-out aggregate, preflight, confirmatory analysis or run report. The sole raw access was the authorized binding-check script reading results.jsonl and displaying counts only. Graders received disjoint blinded cases and the unchanged criteria/pinned source; no prior review context. Answer styles may suggest a strategy.
timestamp_basis: Original creation time (filesystem birthtime) of each completed assessment file, following the unchanged development criteria. ISO8601 America/New_York, microsecond precision exposed by the filesystem API.
validation: All202 exact run_id/job_id/output_sha256 bindings validated against frozen outputs, every available answer covered once, duplicates scored identically, all150 cited/reference excerpt hashes and32 full source files verified, original template/packets/protocol/criteria unchanged.
tally_scope: Only the user-requested overall counts of correctness scores1/0.5/0 are recorded. No means, per-condition results or confirmatory comparisons are computed.
limitations: One AI evaluation workflow with delegated source inspection and root adjudication; no per-item human review or inter-rater reliability estimate.
post_freeze_policy: No score changes after this freeze. If a correction is needed, stop and notify Shekhar.
